newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P upgrades Australian state of Victoria.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P upgrades Australian state of Victoria.

text.p: Ratings Agency Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday it had upgraded the long term local currency debt rating of the Australian state government of Victoria to AA-plus from AA and affirmed its short term rating at A-1 plus.
S&P said it had also raised the local currency ratings of state-government guaranteed entities GASCOR, trading as Gas and Fuel, and Treasury Corp of Victoria to AA plus/A-1 plus from AA/A-1 plus.

"At the same time, the Government of Victoria's long term foreign currency rating has been affirmed at AA, which is constrained by the sovereign ceiling of AA for the Commonwealth Government of Australia," S&P said.
"The local currency rating outlook is revised to stable from positive, while the foreign currency rating outlook remains positive."
The new ratings reflected the significant reduction in the state's debt, the strong position of the government's finances and the state's broad economic base, S&P said.

"The rating fully factors in the anticipated continuation of the sound underlying budgetary position and the support of the state's overall finances from the planned privatisation of the remaining state-owned electricity generation companies," it said.
